messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6586411
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1007/s10544-015-0029-8

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Droplet Microfluidic DNA Bisulfite Conversion (BSC) Module Using Magnetic Bead-Based Methylation on Beads (MOB) Chemistry

REAGENTS USED:
  - Extracted Genomic DNA (gDNA) sample (2 uL per reaction)
  - Ammonium Bisulfite / Zymo Lightning Conversion Reagent (13 uL, sulfonation and hydrolytic deamination of unmethylated cytosine)
  - Silica-Coated Superparamagnetic Beads (SSBs, Promega Magnesil KF MD, 5 uL, solid-phase DNA capture and transport medium)
  - M-Binding Buffer (60 uL, adsorbs sulfonated DNA onto the silica bead surface)
  - Wash Ethanol (40 uL, removes residual bisulfite reagent)
  - M-Desulphonation Buffer (20 uL, sodium hydroxide solution that desulfonates uracil-sulfonate into stable uracil)
  - M-Wash Buffer (40 uL x2, removes residual sodium hydroxide)
  - Elution Buffer / Tris-EDTA Buffer (releases purified, bisulfite-converted DNA from the SSBs)

STEPS:
1. Mix 2 uL of extracted gDNA with 13 uL of Lightning Conversion (bisulfite) reagent and 5 uL of SSBs to form a droplet; load into the first reservoir chamber of the droplet chip.
2. Heat the droplet to 95 C for 8 min to denature the DNA sample into single-stranded DNA.
3. Lower the temperature to 54 C for 1 h to allow the bisulfite to complete deamination of unmethylated cytosine and sulfonation, yielding uracil-sulfonate.
4. Merge the droplet with a 60 uL droplet of M-binding buffer (transported across an open channel by the magnetically-actuated SSB cluster) and briefly incubate to allow the sulfonated DNA to adsorb onto the silica surface of the beads.
5. Transport the SSBs (separated from the reagent droplet across a narrow sieve structure by magnetic force) into a 40 uL ethanol wash droplet to eliminate any remaining bisulfite reagent.
6. Transport the SSBs into a 20 uL M-desulphonation buffer droplet; this alkali solution desulfonates the uracil-sulfonate into stable uracil bases.
7. Wash the SSBs twice, transporting them sequentially into two separate 40 uL M-wash buffer droplets to remove residual sodium hydroxide.
8. Transport the SSBs into the elution (Tris-EDTA) buffer droplet and reverse the DNA-binding process (removing the magnet to allow the beads to disperse and release DNA) to elute the purified, bisulfite-converted DNA.
9. Decant the SSBs into the previous well (magnetically separating the beads from the eluted-DNA droplet) and retrieve the final droplet containing purified, bisulfite-converted DNA from the chip for downstream analysis (e.g., MethyLight qPCR using methylation-specific primers and TaqMan probes).

INTERPRETATION: Successful on-chip bisulfite conversion is confirmed by comparable qPCR cycle threshold (CT) values between the BSC chip and the standard in-tube MOB process (28.34 vs. 28.45, SD 0.14 vs. 0.25) using conversion-specific beta-Actin primers, absence of amplification in the unconverted negative control, and a strong linear relationship (R^2 > 0.99) between input DNA quantity (1-100 ng) and normalized recovered DNA quantity for both methylated and unmethylated ADAMTS1-targeting primer sets, with low variability across replicate lanes and devices, demonstrating that the droplet-based chip matches benchtop bisulfite conversion performance while substantially reducing pipetting steps and processing time.

source.title: Droplet Microfluidic DNA Bisulfite Conversion (BSC) Module Using Magnetic Bead-Based Methylation on Beads (MOB) Chemistry

ir.content:
bsbbif_2_t:
	dispose(eluted_droplet1[0])
bsbbif_3_f:
	PHI eluted_droplet2 = {eluted_droplet1,eluted_droplet}
	NOP
main:
	dna1[0] = dispense(gdna_sample)
	bisulfite1[0] = dispense(bisulfite_reagent)
	beads1[0] = dispense(ssb_beads)
	sample_mix1[0] = mix(dna1[0], bisulfite1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	reaction_droplet1[0] = mix(sample_mix1[0], beads1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	heat(reaction_droplet1[0]) @ 95.0CELSIUS @ 480.0SECOND
	heat(reaction_droplet1[0]) @ 54.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	binding1[0] = dispense(binding_buffer)
	bound_droplet1[0] = mix(reaction_droplet1[0], binding1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	heat(bound_droplet1[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 300.0SECOND
	ethanol1[0] = dispense(wash_ethanol)
	wash1_droplet1[0] = mix(bound_droplet1[0], ethanol1[0]) @ 15.0SECOND
	dispose(wash1_droplet1[0])
	desulf1[0] = dispense(desulfonation_buffer)
	desulf_droplet1[0] = mix(reaction_droplet1[0], desulf1[0]) @ 15.0SECOND
	heat(desulf_droplet1[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 600.0SECOND
	wash21[0] = dispense(wash_buffer)
	wash2_droplet1[0] = mix(desulf_droplet1[0], wash21[0]) @ 15.0SECOND
	dispose(wash2_droplet1[0])
	wash31[0] = dispense(wash_buffer)
	wash3_droplet1[0] = mix(desulf_droplet1[0], wash31[0]) @ 15.0SECOND
	dispose(wash3_droplet1[0])
	elution1[0] = dispense(elution_buffer)
	eluted_droplet1[0] = mix(desulf_droplet1[0], elution1[0]) @ 300.0SECOND
	conversion_signal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, eluted_droplet1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if conversion_signal1[0] < 50	|	true: jump bsbbif_2_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_3_f

chemical_evidence.source_quote: On-chip sample processing begins by first mixing 2 μl of extracted genomic DNA (gDNA)
13 μl of the Lightning Conversion reagent (Zymo)
5 μl of SSB (Promega Magnesil KF MD) to form a droplet that is then loaded into the first reservoir
the droplet is mixed together with a 60 μl droplet of M-binding buffer (step ii) and briefly incubated to allow the DNA to adsorb onto the silica surface of the beads
The SSB are then washed with 40 μl ethanol (step iii) to eliminate any remaining bisulfite reagent
before being transported into a 20 μl M-desulphonation buffer droplet (step iv). This alkali solution desulfonates the uracil-sulfonate into stable uracil bases
The SSB are washed twice in 40 μl M-wash buffer droplets (steps v and vii) in order to remove any residual sodium hydroxide from the solution
the remaining DNA is eluted from the SSB into Tris-EDTA buffer (step vii)

operation_evidence.source_quote: The sample is subsequently heated to 95 °C for 8 min in order to denature the sample into single-stranded DNA (ssDNA)
The temperature is then lowered to 54 °C for 1 h to allow the bisulfite to complete deamination of unmethylated cytosine and sulfonation to yield uracil-sulfonate

operation_evidence.bs_operation: wash1_droplet = mix bound_droplet with ethanol / dispose wash1_droplet

the remaining DNA is eluted from the SSB into Tris-EDTA buffer (step vii) and the SSB are decanted into the previous well to allow the droplet containing purified, bisulfite-converted DNA to be retrieved from the chip for downstream analysis

numeric_mismatches.field: heat bound_droplet at 23c for 5m / heat desulf_droplet at 23c for 10m / eluted_droplet mix for 5m
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper describes these as 'brief' incubations (DNA-binding adsorption) or does not specify exact incubation durations for desulfonation and elution beyond the overall step sequence. The specific minute values used are authored illustrative approximations, not literal figures from the source text.

BioScript has no primitive for magnetic-bead-mediated droplet merging, sieve-based bead separation, or magnet-removal dispersion (Fig. 3b). These mechanisms are approximated using standard 'mix' and 'dispose' operations rather than modeled explicitly.

Stands in for the paper's actual confirmation method, a MethyLight qPCR assay with methylation-specific primers and TaqMan hybridization probes, since BioScript exposes only a single generic detect module rather than a qPCR-specific primitive. The threshold value of 50 is an illustrative placeholder; the paper's actual metric is qPCR cycle threshold (CT) values (e.g., 28.34 for the chip process).

numeric_mismatches.field: chip fabrication (PDMS/ABS mold, plasma bonding, Teflon coating), thermoelectric heating hardware, three-lane parallelization, qPCR master mix/thermocycling
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. These are one-time hardware-fabrication steps or downstream qPCR-analysis details outside the scope of the core droplet-transport bisulfite-conversion protocol translated here.
